summary: Amazon's launch post. The app pairs biological foundation models with an AI agent and lab partners Twist and Ginkgo, with A-Alpha Bio coming. Early users include MSK, Bayer, Broad, Fred Hutch and Voyager.

event_headline: AWS launches Amazon Bio Discovery (agentic AI / bio foundation models)
title: Introducing Amazon Bio Discovery
summary: AWS product blog describing a five-step lab-in-the-loop workflow over 40+ models, custom model uploads and wet-lab cost estimates. Says MSK designed nearly 300,000 antibodies and sent the top 100,000 for testing.

event_headline: AWS launches Amazon Bio Discovery (agentic AI / bio foundation models)
title: AWS Launches Amazon Bio Discovery Agentic AI to Accelerate Drug Development
summary: Reports the launch at AWS's Life Sciences Symposium in New York and the three core capabilities. Mentions an antibody benchmark dataset and model partners Apheris and Boltz, with Biohub and Profluent coming.

event_headline: AWS launches Amazon Bio Discovery (agentic AI / bio foundation models)
title: Amazon launches its AI drug discovery platform
summary: Describes the platform as merging computation and wet-lab work and puts AWS in competition with NVIDIA, Isomorphic Labs and OpenAI in AI drug discovery. Bayer, Broad and Voyager are early testers.

event_headline: OpenAI launches GPT-Rosalind life sciences model (trusted-access preview) + Codex Life Sciences plugin
title: OpenAI introduces GPT-Rosalind: AI model specifically for biology research
summary: Covers GPT-Rosalind and the Codex Life Sciences plug-in, which reaches 50+ tools. Lists OpenAI benchmarks (BixBench 0.751, beat GPT-5.4 on 6 of 11 LABBench2 tasks) and limits access to qualified US enterprises.

event_headline: OpenAI launches GPT-Rosalind life sciences model (trusted-access preview) + Codex Life Sciences plugin
title: OpenAI launches GPT-Rosalind, a reasoning model built for life sciences research
summary: A research preview in ChatGPT, Codex and the API for vetted US enterprises; preview usage won't consume credits. Calls it the first of a planned series of models and names partners including Amgen, Novo Nordisk and Moderna.

event_headline: OpenAI launches GPT-Rosalind life sciences model (trusted-access preview) + Codex Life Sciences plugin
title: OpenAI launches AI model GPT-Rosalind for life sciences research
summary: Reuters wire saying OpenAI launched the biology-focused model on Thursday, with qualified customers getting access through its trusted-access setup, plus a free Codex research plugin. Amgen, Moderna and Thermo Fisher are collaborators.

event_headline: OpenAI launches GPT-Rosalind life sciences model (trusted-access preview) + Codex Life Sciences plugin
title: OpenAI: GPT-Rosalind Life Sciences Model Introduced To Accelerate Drug Discovery And Research Workflows
summary: Recaps the preview and plugin. Adds results from Dyno Therapeutics testing, where the model ranked above the 95th percentile of experts on RNA prediction, and mentions work with Los Alamos.

event_headline: NVIDIA + Google DeepMind + EMBL release precomputed protein-complex structure dataset (GTC 2026)
title: Millions of protein complexes added to AlphaFold Database shed light on how proteins interact
summary: EMBL-EBI, Google DeepMind, NVIDIA and Seoul National University added 1.7M high-confidence homodimer predictions to the AlphaFold Database, out of 30M complexes computed. A May update added about 80,000 heterodimers.

event_headline: NVIDIA + Google DeepMind + EMBL release precomputed protein-complex structure dataset (GTC 2026)
title: NVIDIA GTC 2026: Live Updates on What's Next in AI
summary: NVIDIA's GTC 2026 live blog has a section on the dataset, calling it the world's largest set of protein complexes: 1.7M high-confidence complexes are searchable and about 30M more structures can be bulk-downloaded.

event_headline: Isomorphic Labs raises first external round ($600M; Thrive lead)
title: Isomorphic Labs announces $600m external investment round
summary: Company announcement of its first external round: $600M led by Thrive, with GV joining and follow-on money from Alphabet. Funds go to its next-generation drug design engine and moving programs into the clinic.

event_headline: Isomorphic Labs raises first external round ($600M; Thrive lead)
title: Alphabet's AI drug discovery platform Isomorphic Labs raises $600M from Thrive
summary: Reports the Thrive-led raise as the DeepMind spinout's first outside capital. Notes its 2024 Lilly and Novartis deals, worth up to about $3B in milestones, and Hassabis saying the money mainly helps hiring.

event_headline: Isomorphic Labs raises first external round ($600M; Thrive lead)
title: Alphabet-Backed Isomorphic Labs Raises $600M For AI Drug Development
summary: Covers the $600M first external round led by Thrive with GV and Alphabet, and compares it with other large AI drug rounds such as Xaira's $1B and Formation Bio's $372M.

event_headline: Isomorphic Labs raises first external round ($600M; Thrive lead)
title: Isomorphic Labs Secures $600M to Accelerate AI-Powered Drug Discovery
summary: Reports the round and investors and notes that Isomorphic's internal pipeline focuses mainly on oncology and immunology, with plans to take programs into clinical trials.

event_headline: Recursion completes merger with Exscientia
title: Recursion and Exscientia, two leaders in the AI drug discovery space, have officially combined to advance the industrialization of drug discovery
summary: Joint release filed with the SEC: the combination closed and Exscientia became a wholly owned Recursion subsidiary, with its ADSs delisted from Nasdaq. Outlines the combined pipeline, partnerships and new leadership roles.

event_headline: Recursion completes merger with Exscientia
title: Recursion and Exscientia, two leaders in the AI drug discovery space, have officially combined to advance the industrialization of drug discovery
summary: Wire copy of the closing release, citing over 10 clinical and preclinical programs, over 10 partnered programs, about $450M in partner payments received, and over $20B in possible future milestones.

event_headline: Recursion completes merger with Exscientia
title: Recursion Completes Merger with Exscientia, Expanding AI Drug Discovery Platform
summary: Reports that the merger closed, making Exscientia a Recursion subsidiary and delisting its shares. Quotes Chris Gibson on the enlarged pipeline and David Hallett on faster discovery through proprietary data.

event_headline: Recursion completes merger with Exscientia
title: Recursion acquires Exscientia
summary: Short write-up of the completed combination: a vertically integrated AI discovery platform with over 10 internal programs and over $450M collected from partners.

event_headline: AlphaFold 3 released by Google DeepMind & Isomorphic Labs
title: AlphaFold 3 predicts the structure and interactions of all of life's molecules
summary: Joint announcement of AlphaFold 3, published in Nature, which models proteins, DNA, RNA, ligands and modifications. It claims at least 50% better accuracy on protein interactions, with free non-commercial access via the AlphaFold Server.

event_headline: AlphaFold 3 released by Google DeepMind & Isomorphic Labs
title: AlphaFold 3 predicts the structure and interactions of all of life's molecules
summary: Isomorphic's copy of the announcement. Reports a 50% gain over the best traditional methods on the PoseBusters docking benchmark and describes the diffusion-based architecture.

event_headline: AlphaFold 3 released by Google DeepMind & Isomorphic Labs
title: 'Bigger, faster, better': Isomorphic, DeepMind unveil AlphaFold 3, going beyond protein predictions
summary: Endpoints reports that the new AlphaFold version reaches well beyond single-protein structure prediction. Most of the article is behind a registration wall.

event_headline: AlphaFold 3 released by Google DeepMind & Isomorphic Labs
title: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs reveal AI able to predict large swathes of molecular biology
summary: Gives accuracy figures: 76% on protein-small molecule interactions versus 52% for prior tools, and 65% on DNA. Notes that outside researchers get only web access, not the code, and the model still struggles with disordered proteins.

event_headline: AlphaFold 3 released by Google DeepMind & Isomorphic Labs
title: Isomorphic Labs, Google DeepMind introduce new AI molecule predicting model
summary: Summarizes the Nature paper and AlphaFold Server launch. Recalls Isomorphic's January 2024 Lilly ($45M upfront) and Novartis ($37.5M upfront) discovery deals.

event_headline: Xaira Therapeutics launches with >$1B
title: Xaira Therapeutics Launches to Deliver Transformative Medicines by Advancing and Harnessing AI for Drug Discovery and Development
summary: Launch release: over $1B committed, led by ARCH and Foresite, which incubated Xaira with Foresite Labs, plus F-Prime, NEA, Sequoia and others. Marc Tessier-Lavigne is CEO; co-founders include David Baker and Hetu Kamisetty.

event_headline: Xaira Therapeutics launches with >$1B
title: Exclusive: In $1B+ bet on AI, biopharma heavyweights back new startup to upend drug R&D
summary: Endpoints' exclusive on the launch calls Xaira one of the year's most richly funded startups. Tessier-Lavigne argues small AI gains at each stage could multiply into two- to threefold improvements in speed and success.

event_headline: Xaira Therapeutics launches with >$1B
title: AI Drug Developer Xaira Therapeutics Launches with $1B+
summary: Says Xaira took in Illumina's functional genomics team and Interline's proteomics group. ARCH calls it the largest initial commitment in the firm's history; board members include Bertozzi, Gorsky and Gottlieb.

event_headline: Xaira Therapeutics launches with >$1B
title: Xaira, an AI drug discovery startup, launches with a massive $1B, says it's 'ready' to start developing drugs
summary: Reports that Xaira spent about six months in stealth, builds on Baker's diffusion-style protein design models, and gave no timeline for human trials. Recaps the Stanford inquiry behind Tessier-Lavigne's resignation.

event_headline: Ipsen to acquire Memo Therapeutics (>€700M)
title: Ipsen to acquire Memo Therapeutics AG
summary: Ipsen will buy Swiss biotech Memo for €200M at closing plus development, regulatory and sales milestones, bringing total value above €700M, to gain the Phase 2 BK polyomavirus antibody potravitug.

event_headline: Ipsen to acquire Memo Therapeutics (>€700M)
title: Ipsen to acquire Memo Therapeutics
summary: Puts the deal at up to roughly $800M and frames it as a rare-disease push targeting BK virus in kidney transplant recipients.

event_headline: Takeda–Insilico AI drug discovery pact (up to ~$600M)
title: Insilico Medicine announces collaboration with Takeda to advance strategic AI drug discovery
summary: Insilico will use Pharma.AI to find candidates in Takeda's therapy areas for about $60M in early payments and up to roughly $600M total plus royalties; Takeda takes selected molecules into the clinic.

event_headline: QuantumCell licenses AlzeCure's NeuroRestore platform (>$2.2B)
title: Biotech BD&L tracker 2026

title: PureTech founded entity Celea Therapeutics completes $180 million financing
summary: Celea raised $180M from RA Capital, Leaps by Bayer, PureTech and two unnamed large investors to run SURPASS-IPF, a head-to-head Phase 3 of deupirfenidone against pirfenidone in IPF.

event_headline: AstraZeneca licenses two CSPC kidney siRNAs (up to ~$1.77B)

event_headline: FORE Biotherapeutics raises $67.4M Series D-2 extension

summary: Lists a $67.4M Series D-2 extension for FORE Biotherapeutics co-led by SR One, Medicxi and SymBiosis.

event_headline: MindRank raises $52M Series B for oral GLP-1 MDR-001
title: MindRank rises through the ranks with $52m Series B for oral GLP-1

event_headline: Drug Farm raises $55M Series D first close

event_headline: Draig Therapeutics raises $65M Series B
title: Draig Therapeutics closes oversubscribed $65 million Series B
summary: Deep Track led Draig's $65M Series B with Janus Henderson, Marshall Wace and others, funding Phase 2 work on AMPA potentiator DT-101 in depression and its GABAA modulators.

event_headline: AstraZeneca licenses Dizal's Zegfrovy ($600M upfront, up to $1.5B)

summary: AstraZeneca pays $600M upfront and up to $900M in milestones, plus royalties, for global rights to Dizal's oral EGFR inhibitor sunvozertinib (Zegfrovy) for lung cancer.

event_headline: AdvanCell raises $315M Series D for Pb-212 alpha therapies

title: Biotech BD&L tracker 2026

event_headline: Eli Lilly to acquire AtaiBeckley (~$2.8B; up to ~$3.8B with CVR)

summary: Lilly offers $6.75 a share in cash (~$2.8B) plus a CVR worth up to $2.50 a share tied to BPL-003 and VLS-01 milestones, for up to about $3.8B.

event_headline: Eli Lilly to acquire AtaiBeckley (~$2.8B; up to ~$3.8B with CVR)
title: Lilly to buy psychedelics developer AtaiBeckley
summary: Frames the deal as a sign that big pharma is warming to psychedelic medicines for depression.

event_headline: Repligen to acquire BioLife Solutions (~$1.5B)
title: Repligen strikes $1.5B BioLife buyout

event_headline: Crystalys raises $130M Series B for gout drug dotinurad

summary: Frazier-led $130M round funds two Phase 3 trials and a Phase 2 study of the URAT1 inhibitor dotinurad in gout, plus launch preparation; the drug is already approved in several Asian markets.

title: Scribe Therapeutics announces pricing of upsized initial public offering
summary: Scribe sold 8.58M shares at $15 for $128.7M gross, with trading starting July 24 under SCTX; lead program STX-1150 epigenetically silences PCSK9 to lower LDL cholesterol.

title: Dassault Systèmes to acquire ArisGlobal
summary: Dassault will pay about $1.8B in cash plus up to $200M in AI-revenue earnouts for ArisGlobal, whose safety, regulatory and quality software is used by roughly half of the top 50 biopharmas.

event_headline: argenx to acquire Forte Biosciences (~$2.2B)
title: argenx to acquire Forte Biosciences
summary: argenx will pay $77 a share in cash, about $2.2B in equity value, for Forte and its anti-CD122 antibody FB102.

event_headline: argenx to acquire Forte Biosciences (~$2.2B)
title: argenx to acquire Forte Biosciences
summary: Notes FB102 has early positive data in celiac disease and vitiligo with Phase 2 results due later in the year.

event_headline: J&J–Sail Biomedicines in vivo CAR-T deal ($785M initial; $2.58B buyout option)
title: Johnson & Johnson announces collaboration with Sail Biomedicines
summary: J&J commits $785M upfront, including a $465M equity stake, plus $140M in milestones and a $2.58B option to buy Sail, to advance its in vivo CAR-T program for autoimmune disease.

event_headline: Apnimed prices $192M upsized IPO (APMD)

event_headline: Ratio Therapeutics raises $70M Series C
title: Biotech VC funding tracker 2026

event_headline: AbbVie licenses Zelgen cancer asset ex-China (up to ~$1.2B)

summary: Earendil will use its AI-driven biologics platform to discover bispecific antibodies for Sanofi in autoimmune disease; total potential value up to $2.56B.

event_headline: Amgen acquires Dark Blue Therapeutics (up to $840M)
title: Amgen Acquires Dark Blue Therapeutics, Bolstering Oncology Pipeline

event_headline: Lilly–Nimbus oral obesity research & license deal (up to $1.355B)
title: Nimbus Therapeutics Announces Research Collaboration and License Agreement with Lilly for Novel Oral Obesity Treatment
summary: Nimbus will apply its computational chemistry platform to an oral obesity program for Lilly, with total potential payments up to about $1.355B.

title: Lilly to acquire Ventyx Biosciences to advance oral therapies targeting inflammatory-mediated diseases
summary: Lilly agreed to buy Ventyx for about $1.2B in cash, adding oral NLRP3 inhibitors in Phase 2 for pericarditis and cardiovascular risk plus IBD candidates.

title: Corsera Health Announces $80 Million Series A Financing and Reaches Key Clinical Milestone
summary: Forbion and Population Health Partners co-led the $80M round; Corsera also began Phase 1 dosing of COR-1004, a subcutaneous PCSK9 siRNA for cardiovascular prevention.

title: Poplar Therapeutics Launches With $50M Series A to Advance a New Class of Anti-IgE Therapy for Multiple Atopic Conditions
summary: Formerly Phylaxis Bioscience, Poplar launched with $50M to run Phase 1 of PHB-050, an anti-IgE antibody meant to drive IgE levels near zero for food allergy and atopic disease.

summary: Proceeds advance Mediar's anti-fibrotic programs, including an EphrinB2 antagonist in Phase 2a for systemic sclerosis.

event_headline: Parabilis Medicines raises $305M (Series F)
title: Biotech Funding Rounds 2026

summary: Alveus raised $159.8M for Phase 2 of ALV-100 in obesity and IND filings for earlier candidates including a selective amylin peptide agonist.

event_headline: Beacon Therapeutics raises $75M+ Series C
title: Beacon Therapeutics Announces Closing of Oversubscribed Series C Financing for Over $75 Million
summary: Ocular gene therapy company raised more than $75M to advance laru-zova for X-linked retinitis pigmentosa.

event_headline: Aktis Oncology prices upsized Nasdaq IPO at $18/share (~$365M incl. option)
title: Biotech IPO tracker 2026

event_headline: AirNexis Therapeutics launches with $200M Series A

summary: AirNexis launched with $200M and an in-licensed Phase 2 dual PDE3/4 inhibitor for COPD; led by CEO Maria Fardis.

event_headline: bit.bio raises $50M Series C

summary: Funds development of inhaled frevecitinib for severe asthma patients, including non-eosinophilic disease.
